title: TEHRAN – October 8, 2026 – Iran's President Masoud Pezeshkian delivered remarks before leaving for Turkminisatan to participate in CIS conferemce.
text:
TEHRAN – October 8, 2026 – Iran's President Masoud Pezeshkian delivered remarks before leaving for Turkminisatan to participate in CIS conferemce."

""
"SOT1, Masoud Pezeshkian, Iran's President (Farsi)-(00:00 - 00:57): " [on the sidelines of CIS Convention] In addition to discussing environmental damage and how we should manage it, heads of state will engage in talks regarding multilateral relations and combating unilateralism, as well as potential cooperation in energy and various commercial, cultural, political, and security matters. Before us, the relevant ministers are present and are discussing matters within the commission. This is a very good opportunity for us to deepen our relations with our neighbors and increase our communications; regarding the problem they have created for us by imposing a naval blockade, in my opinion, they cannot blockade us so easily, as we are neighbors with 15 countries in the region.""

""
"SOT2, Masoud Pezeshkian, Iran's President (Farsi)-(00:58 - 01:53): "This trip is at the invitation of the honorable President of Turkmenistan, Serdar Berdimuhamedov. In fact, we are traveling, and there are two issues regarding this trip: first, we are guests at the meeting of the Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS) where their leaders are present, and second, the countries located on the Caspian Sea, in order to discuss the process of the Caspian [Convention] which is currently facing risks. This is an asset for future generations and our environment; if it is destroyed, it will create many problems for all the countries that are neighbors situated along the Caspian Sea.
